The '''Nightsister Stronghold''' was located on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]]. It served as a refugee settlement for the exiled witches.

Right outside the walls of the stronghold was the entrance to the [[Rancor Cave]], where many [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] lived.<ref name="SWG:RC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=poi|Rancor Cave|Dathomir}}</ref> The entrance to the [[Chamber of Banishment]] could be found in the deepest part of the caverns.<ref name="SWG:AM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=heroic|Axkva Min}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Night_Sisters_Main_Base_concept_art.jpg_|thumb|right|220px|Concept art for ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.]]
The Nightsister Stronghold was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:NS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
